datasets.name: ds_runs
queryLines: SELECT *, CASE WHEN is_capability_guide_job THEN 'Capability guide jobs' ELSE 'Other workspace jobs' END AS scope, CASE WHEN result_state IN ('ERROR','FAILED','TIMED_OUT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS failed_flag FROM ops_job_runs

datasets.name: ds_failures
queryLines: SELECT *, CASE WHEN is_capability_guide_job THEN 'Capability guide jobs' ELSE 'Other workspace jobs' END AS scope FROM ops_failures

datasets.name: ds_capacity_usage
queryLines: SELECT capacity_date, workload_type, detail, value AS dbus FROM ops_compute_capacity WHERE source = 'serverless_usage'

datasets.name: ds_capacity_wh
queryLines: SELECT capacity_date, split(detail, ' / ')[0] AS event_type, split(detail, ' / ')[1] AS warehouse_id, value AS events FROM ops_compute_capacity WHERE source = 'warehouse_event'

datasets.name: ds_audit_top_actions
queryLines: SELECT event_date, concat(service_name, '.', action_name) AS action, user_email, events FROM ops_audit_events WHERE concat(service_name, action_name) IN (SELECT concat(service_name, action_name) FROM ops_audit_events GROUP BY service_name, action_name ORDER BY sum(events) DESC LIMIT 12)

datasets.name: ds_audit_top_users
queryLines: SELECT event_date, user_email, events FROM ops_audit_events WHERE user_email IN (SELECT user_email FROM ops_audit_events GROUP BY user_email ORDER BY sum(events) DESC LIMIT 10)

datasets.name: ds_routing
queryLines: SELECT *, CASE WHEN is_capability_guide_job THEN 'Capability guide jobs' ELSE 'Other workspace jobs' END AS scope FROM ops_alert_routing
